composers_checked.name: Mozart, Wolfgang Amadeus
composers_checked.note: Complete: all 131 candidate pages kept or skipped; gap check against the Wikipedia list of compositions (chamber music, divertimenti, church sonatas). Floor and durations from Apple Music (iTunes Search API): minutes are the median of complete recordings. Added from the gap check: the piano concertos K. 413, 414, 415 and 449 in Mozart's own "a quattro" version (piano and string quartet), each recorded by several pianist-and-quartet pairs.

note: Decisions to review: (1) The 14 church sonatas for two violins, bass and organ are kept as continuo chamber works (trio-sonata scoring, recorded one to a part); the 2 with trumpets/timpani are skipped as orchestral. (2) K. 404a Preludes and Fugues kept, marked doubtful in notes. (3) The concertos K. 413-415 and 449 "a quattro" are given formation "other" like the solo showpieces with quartet accompaniment. (4) K. 10-15 skipped as duos: the cello is ad lib. and they are in the violin catalogue. (5) K. 405 (Bach fugues arranged for quartet) is not added: an arrangement of another composer. The violin entries K. 46d/46e (violin and bass) are duos and stay out. Level guesses for the church sonatas and the concerto versions are rough.
